test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"The truth must be told by you."

options.text: You must have told the truth
You ought to tell the truth.
You must be telling the truth.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The truth must be told by you."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "you" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "must be told" to "must tell" (active modal verb structure).
 
• Ensure the object "the truth" remains after the verb for proper sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You must tell the truth."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "You must have told the truth." – Incorrect tense (past modal).
 
• **Option 2:** "You ought to tell the truth." – Incorrect modal verb usage ("ought to" instead of "must").
 
• **Option 3:** "You must be telling the truth." – Incorrect aspect (present continuous).
